# Muro

> Muro is an explicit affine dependent type theory built for agents to write: the agent writes the program together with its types, motives and proofs, nothing is inferred, and `mix muro.check` accepts or rejects every definition. Definitions are tagged `spec`, `evidence` or `run`; a spec never becomes evidence and evidence never becomes a run. Proofs are erased, and only `run` terms are emitted. The default emitter is Elixir. `--backend c` writes C, `--backend rust` writes Rust, `--backend asm` writes Cortex-M assembly, and `--backend otp` writes a GenServer for a session. A closed `Nat` run is also a NIF. `--node` writes one call for a cross. Agda specifies the calculus and proves the checker sound on a fragment. Agda does not check the `.muro` file.

Nothing is inferred: there are no implicits, unification, metavariables or tactics, and every binder and motive is written out. A `?` always fails. Recursion in `run`, `evidence`, and `spec` must descend. Agents should read the For agents page first, and copy syntax from the files in `examples/` rather than writing it from memory. `out of fuel` is not acceptance; raise `--fuel` and check again.

## Docs

- [Manual](https://muro-lang.dev/docs): What Muro is, how to read this book, and the three documentation layers.
- [For agents](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/for-agents): Two jobs. Do not mix them. Commands and file map.
- [Start](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/start): Install, write a .muro file, check it, emit Elixir.
- [Marks](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/marks): Π, λ, modes, data, atoms, and streams, one paragraph each.
- [The wall](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/wall): spec, evidence, and run. Promotion is forbidden.
- [Terms](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/language): Type, Π, λ, match, quantities, and the book.
- [Sessions](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/sessions): A session is the protocol two processes follow.
- [Grammar](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/grammar): The surface grammar lib/muro/parser.ex implements.
- [Identity](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/identity): Equations, refl, rewrite, and explicit motives.
- [Data](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/data): Inductive types, positivity, Maybe, List, Tree.
- [Indexed data](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/indexed): Fin, Vec, and lookup without a runtime bounds check.
- [Streams](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/streams): ν, unfold, Always, and bisimulation.
- [Either and Dec](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/either): Disjoint union and decisions. Not LEM.
- [Machine numbers](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/machine): I64, F32, Tensor, and Nx. Nat stays Peano.
- [Emit](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/emit): What becomes Elixir. C and Rust print the closed run. A Nat run is a NIF. Cortex-M prints a Nat run. OTP writes a conforming process. A cross is one call on a named node. Spec and evidence are omitted from a run.
- [Limits](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/limits): What the language does not do. Facts about the checker, not a roadmap.

## Examples

- [Examples](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/examples): Every file in examples/ and what it is for.
- [half_ok.muro](https://github.com/murolang/muro/blob/main/examples/half_ok.muro): The canonical book: a spec, a program, and a theorem about it.
- [examples/ on GitHub](https://github.com/murolang/muro/tree/main/examples): All example programs.

## Repository

- [murolang/muro](https://github.com/murolang/muro): Source, README, CI (Elixir tests and `make agda`).
- [muro on Hex](https://hex.pm/packages/muro): The Mix package; check files with `mix muro.check`.

## Optional

- [Extending the kernel](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/extending): How to change the type theory. Agda first, then Elixir.
- [CSHRL](https://muro-lang.dev/docs/cshrl): Coinductive symmetric homomorphisms for RL, as a library on params, with three environments and their agents.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/murolang/muro/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history.
